StockViewer

Subscribe to and watch China A-share stock quotes in the console.

Usage:
  stockviewer subscribe <symbol> [symbol...]
  stockviewer unsubscribe <symbol> [symbol...]
  stockviewer list
  stockviewer watch [symbol...] [-i seconds] [--once] [--hide-name] [--alert-pct percent]

  Press H to toggle name display while watching.
  Press A to cycle alert threshold: 3% 5% 10% Off.

Examples:
  stockviewer subscribe 600000 000001 300750
  stockviewer watch
  stockviewer watch sh600519 sz000001 -i 3 --once --hide-name
